atoms.name: Evaluation functions
atoms.one_line: UCS: $f=g$. Greedy: $f=h$. A*: $f=g+h$. With $h\equiv0$, A* is UCS.

atoms.name: Greedy best-first behaviour
atoms.one_line: Expands the lowest $h$; fast but can return a costly path and, as tree search, loop.

atoms.name: A* expansion order
atoms.one_line: Remove the lowest $f$; break ties as stated; test the goal on removal; re-open a node reached with lower $g$.

atoms.name: Admissibility
atoms.one_line: $h(n)\le h^*(n)$ for all $n$: never overestimates. Gives optimal A* tree search.

atoms.name: Consistency
atoms.one_line: $h(n)\le c(n,n')+h(n')$ on every edge, $h(\text{goal})=0$. Implies admissible; makes $f$ non-decreasing.

atoms.name: Dominance and combining heuristics
atoms.one_line: $h_2\ge h_1$ dominates. max and min of admissible (or consistent) are fine; the sum is not.

atoms.name: IDA*
atoms.one_line: Iterative deepening on $f$: the next threshold is the smallest $f$ that exceeded the last.

atoms.name: Bounding h values
atoms.one_line: Largest admissible $h(n)$ is $h^*(n)$, the true cheapest cost to a goal; consistency gives interval bounds.
